title: Competitive drift detection and field-ready action library for specialty models
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable pipeline that detects competitive model drift in narrow-domain offerings (medical triage, legal summarization, fintech compliance) and maps each detected drift to a curated action from a field-ready action library (e.g., roll to fallback variant, increase quantization tolerance, trigger private deployment procurement). Deliverables: detection heuristics, telemetry requirements, a ranked action catalog with playbook steps, and an integration spec for Console alerts and PagerDuty hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Automated detection rules that flag >= 90% of synthetic drift scenarios in the benchmark suite
Action library with at least 12 mapped responses, each with playbook steps, estimated cost delta, and rollback criteria
Console prototype showing per-model drift score, suggested actions, and one-click create-runbook flow
Integration spec and PoC webhook that emits alerts to PagerDuty and attaches contextual evidence (example prompts, delta metrics)
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: aligned on scope with Eng (Priya), Research (Oumar), and Solutions (Nina). Focus on specialty verticals where small behaviour changes break SLAs.

2026-03-05 - Decision: initial drift signals will include: prompt-response distribution shift, latency uplift vs baseline, token-level perplexity delta on in-domain prompts, and embedding drift for retrieval-augmented tasks. Chosen to balance detection power and runtime cost.
2026-03-08 - Trade-off noted by Eng: running full perplexity checks on production traffic is expensive. Agreed to sample 0.5% of requests and run heavier checks in a synthetic replay job.

2026-03-10 - Review feedback from Solutions: add explicit customer-impact mapping to actions (e.g., compliance-critical -> immediate failover; low-risk -> canary assignment). Action library draft updated.
2026-03-12 - PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/model-drift/pull/217) for telemetry schema. Eng requested additional fields: model_variant_id and inference_node_region.
2026-03-14 - Research ran synthetic drift suite across 9 domain models; detection recall preliminary: 0.92, precision: 0.68. Need to tighten false positives before wider alerts.
2026-03-15 - Next: build Console mock for alert UX (owner: Design - Samir) and wire a PagerDuty PoC (owner: SRE - Keiko).
